clearance_definition: signed radius-minus-distance to the best centerline segment across the union of BranchWithRadii tubes; positive inside the modeled tube and negative outside every modeled tube
why_negative_values_can_coexist_with_zer: The static centerline-radius tube approximation is not identical to the SOFA collision mesh or contact constraint state. It is a current-state geometric descriptor, not a measured contact-force surrogate.
original_max_absolute_sine_exemplar_cave: The automatic maximum-|sin| exemplar in geometry_feature_validation.csv is angularly wall-directed but has negative proxy clearance; the in-lumen example above is the physically clearer interpretation.
continuity_caveat: Large finite jumps in the projected angle can occur when nearest centerline segment or tracked distal direction changes; repeated queries at a fixed state were bitwise identical, and original task transitions reproduced exactly.
